answer.summary: The E2E job failed because the OpenAEV app never became ready: /api/me did not return 200 after 300s (last HTTP 000). Spring's failure-analysis reporter logged an ERROR at startup, but the excerpt cuts off before the actual cause. Migrations ran through V6_20261112060000000, so the root cause is probably a startup/config failure, which usually repeats on re-run. The log does not show the cause, so treat this as low confidence and check the full startup log for the Spring failure analysis.
